rules.rule: Long-form videos must maintain semantic scene diversity
Fallback/default scenes are forbidden in production
Grid children use parent-relative layout; do not reuse global absolute coordinates inside repeated cells
Every beat must have measured VOICEVOX start/end timing
rules.condition: sync-timing beats count equals script beats count

rules.rule: Shared pronunciation dictionary is applied immediately before VOICEVOX synthesis
Pronunciation substitutions are logged as an artifact
Registered shared templates and pronunciation rules must not be copied back into per-video implementations
rules.condition: video manifest declares shared production system version

rules.rule: Video records rule registry versions used for production
QA contact sheet is required before release
